title: The pyramid tarot spread
description: How the six-card pyramid tarot spread works: what each position means, how to lay it out, how to read the layers, and a worked example.

scenes.headline: The pyramid tarot spread
scenes.caption: The pyramid tarot spread builds from a base of three cards to a single card at the top. It suits questions about what to do next.
scenes.vo: The pyramid tarot spread builds from a base of three cards to a single card at the top. It suits questions about what to do next.

scenes.headline: The six positions
scenes.caption: Read the base row first, left to right, then work upward.
scenes.vo: The six positions. Read the base row first, left to right, then work upward.

scenes.headline: How to lay it out
scenes.caption: Place cards 1, 2 and 3 in a row along the bottom, with a little space between them.
